ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 90% of the visible surface is high-intensity white/light-grey pixels, bordered by a low-intensity dark pigmentation band (approximately 10% surface area) concentrated along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white field across both lobes. A distinct, high-contrast dark ovoid spot is located in the upper-central region of the left lobe. A continuous, jagged dark-pigmented band follows the trailing edge from the left tip to the right tip, varying in width from 5 to 25 pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and a vertical depth of 45 pixels relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; amplitude of peaks varies between 3 and 12 pixels. The right lobe exhibits more pronounced jaggedness near the distal tip compared to the more rounded peaks near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips, while the lower leading edges follow a symmetric convex curve upward and outward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast yellowish-white pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Smaller high-intensity circular clusters are visible along the upper-left trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of faint, unaligned reddish-brown linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) appearing horizontally on the upper-right lobe surface near the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable dark focal spot on the left lobe and significant asymmetric tearing/irregularity of the trailing edge contour, particularly a prominent notch on the inner-right lobe edge.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific 2D coordinate positioning of the dark focal spot on the left lobe relative to the median notch provides a highly unique identifier.
